LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 3.1.1 LISTENING FOR THE MAIN IDEA

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.1: Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for the main idea
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for the main idea, part of Strand 3 in Grade 7 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: What can you do to ensure you capture the main ideas from a speaker?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to audio recordings on hygiene and identify the main idea,

2. listen for specific information from the audio recording on hygiene and take notes,

3. search online and offline for expressions that signal the main ideas, such as; this talk is about... I will talk about...,

4. watch a video describing a process, a person, or an object and pick out specific information,

5. listen to peers read descriptive texts, and note down the main ideas in turns.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to audio recordings on hygiene and identify the main idea,
2. listen for specific information from the audio recording on hygiene and take notes,
3. search online and offline for expressions that signal the main ideas, such as; this talk is about... I will talk about...,
4. watch a video describing a process, a person, or an object and pick out specific information,
5. listen to peers read descriptive texts, and note down the main ideas in turns.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for the main idea together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication : It is enhanced as the learner listens keenly and responds to descriptive texts.

• Digital literacy is achieved as the learner uses digital devices to search online for expressions that signal the main idea and

specific information.

Values:
Respect is enhanced as the learner listens keenly to peers reading descriptive texts and noting the main ideas.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Health education - personal hygiene is promoted as the learner listens to audio texts on hygiene.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Learners relate to concepts in Agriculture as they listen to a recording on hygiene.
